methodology.summary: Each acceptance criterion is binary: done only when verified by a file, git history, GitHub issue/API output, or a tool command. Milestone percent is completed criteria divided by total criteria. Overall percent is the sum of milestone weight multiplied by completed criteria divided by total criteria.
methodology.arithmetic: Governance and evidence base: 8 * 4/4 = 8.0000; Development environment and target build capability: 12 * 4/5 = 9.6000; Art direction and asset pipeline: 15 * 10/17 = 8.8235; Playable Flutter game implementation: 45 * 17/17 = 45.0000; Offline, privacy, accessibility, and monetization promises: 10 * 16/18 = 8.8889; QA, release, and store readiness: 5 * 22/27 = 4.0741; Public status dashboard: 5 * 5/5 = 5.0000; total = 89.3865 of 100

milestones.name: Offline, privacy, accessibility, and monetization promises

acceptance_criteria.evidence: AGENTS.md documents the fixed free-core/no-ads/no-tracking/offline-first monetization contract.
The committed app is an offline local game with no backend/account/tracking integration recorded; lib/main.dart states offline-first: no backend, account, ads, or tracking.
lib/ui/settings_screen.dart states the game runs entirely on-device with no account and no advertising.
Two accessible palettes, Warm and High contrast, are user-selectable and persisted through lib/data/local_store.dart.
The reduce-motion preference is additive only: it ORs with the platform disableAnimations flag, so user preference can add restraint but never remove the platform setting.
LinefallPalette.byName falls back to the default for unknown or corrupt stored values; this is covered by a test.
Stats are local counts only: per-opponent win/loss/draw records, no timestamps, no move logs, nothing identifying; pass-and-play is deliberately not recorded.
The daily puzzle has no countdown, no streak, no penalty for a wrong guess, and the correct answer still works after a wrong one; only solved days are stored and the list is bounded to 400 entries.
The daily puzzle is fully playable with no store at all, covered by a test, and is free with no gate or purchase prompt.
The 20 strategy lessons have no score, no streak, no timer, and a wrong answer leaves the position untouched so it can be retried immediately.
Only completed lessons are stored as a bookmark; corrupt stored lesson entries are skipped rather than crashing, and lessons work with no store at all. Both behaviours are covered by tests.
A test asserts that no lesson screen contains unlock, upgrade, buy, or premium, and another asserts the home-screen entry says Twenty short lessons. All free.

Optional theme backgrounds obey accessibility constraints by test: every image sits under a palette scrim of at least 0.55, high-contrast suppresses backgrounds entirely, images are excluded from semantics, and an unknown stored id falls back to none.

Production privacy disclosure artifact exists: lib/ui/privacy_screen.dart is generated from LocalStore.disclosure, docs/PRIVACY.md records store privacy answers, and test/privacy_test.dart verifies disclosure coverage, no networking markers/dependencies, and no Android INTERNET permission.
Release APK builds and aapt2 dump permissions shows no INTERNET permission.
Player identity is carried by mark and colour; b845574 replaced colour-only player labels and test/identity_test.dart prevents regression.

premium_strategy_pack has an honest purchase surface in lib/data/entitlements.dart and lib/ui/premium_screen.dart, but no real store backend is wired up. Default backend is unavailable, buy is disabled as Not on sale yet, and real sale requires owner-held store product IDs.
Store forms have not been submitted and no developer account exists, so store privacy submission/readiness is not done.
